messages.呼吸を貯めてクリティカルを出し、S3で弾丸を撃って振動と破裂をまとめて入れる人格: An Identity that builds Poise for critical hits, then fires ammunition with S3 to apply both Tremor and Rupture.
messages.呼吸で強化: S1「押しのける」・S2「夕・む」は自分の呼吸7以上でコイン威力+: **Poise bonuses**: S1 Shove and S2 T.N. gain +1 Coin Power with at least 7 Poise. S3 O.O.F. gains +1 Coin Power with at least 10 Poise (+1 per 7 Poise, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.クリティカル時のデバフ: S1はクリティカル時に対象の精神力を減らし、S2は攻撃: **Debuffs on Critical Hit**: On Critical Hit, S1 reduces the target's SP, and S2 inflicts Offense Level Down.
messages.S3: Ⅲコインで弾丸1を消耗し、振動・破裂の付与と振動爆発。クリティカル時は振: **S3**: Coin Ⅲ spends 1 Ammo to inflict Tremor and Rupture and trigger Tremor Burst. On Critical Hit, the Tremor and Rupture Potency and Count are doubled.
messages.バトルパッシブ「ヤ・切」(暴食×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 弾丸7を保有。ター: **Combat passive — A S.B. (2 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Holds 7 Ammo. Restores 8 SP at Turn End if she has at least 7 Poise.
messages.S2・S3で呼吸を貯め(S1は呼吸回数を補う)、S3のⅢコインでクリティカルを狙: Build Poise with S2 and S3 (S1 tops up Poise Count), then aim for a Critical Hit with Coin Ⅲ of S3 to inflict doubled Tremor and Rupture. Ammo comes from the passive A S.B., so Uptie Ⅱ or higher is a prerequisite. Keeping Poise at 7 or more also restores SP.
